rules.description: The stream's admitted position is a reference to a canonical Agentgres operation; the family owns no head scalar of its own.
The stream identity is bound to its declared owner namespace: a stream cannot claim one namespace in its id while declaring another, which is what would let a second customer masquerade as the first.
Every stream declares at least one admitted-truth class: a stream that admits nothing is a delivery channel, not an event stream.
